title.en: The Rump Court's Grain Registers

desc.zh: 外贝加尔的小朝廷还捧着两本册子：一本记旗丁的月粮，一本记垦户的税粮。册子越旧，欠得越多；先把粮册理清，才谈得上别的。
desc.en: The small court at Transbaikal still holds two registers: one for the bannermen's monthly grain, one for the settlers' tax grain. The older the books, the larger the arrears; only by putting the grain registers in order does anything else become possible.

title.en: Subjects Beyond the Style

desc.zh: 朝廷的名号之下，还住着布里亚特牧户、哥萨克垦户与海岛上的通信人。谁能算朝廷的属民、谁只算客籍，以及往来书信该用谁的名号，将决定留下的究竟是朝廷还是别的什么。
desc.en: Beneath the dynastic style live Buryat herders, Cossack settlers and correspondents across the sea. Who counts as the court's own, who stays a registered guest, and whose name the letters carry, will decide whether what remains is a court or something else.

title.en: The Eight Banners Still Must Eat Grain

desc.zh: 户部的旧册还按月记着旗丁的米粮，可陆上的地租连俸库都填不满。管票的章京把两本册子摊在案上：旗饷一日不改，垦户的税就一日收不齐。
desc.en: The old board register still records the bannermen's monthly grain, yet the land rents on the steppe can no longer fill the stipend stores. The secretary in charge of ration tickets spreads both books on the desk: while the stipend goes unchanged, the settlers' tax can never be collected in full.

title.en: Banner Lands and Plough Furrows

desc.zh: 科尔沁的旗册认牧道，新垦的田契认犁沟，两本册子在同一个旗署里对不上账。盟旗的兵额、租谷的税源、牧道的存废，都要先从这两册并一册说起。

desc.en: With the banner-land and furrow accounts settled, Khorchin faces the league without and the next generation within: whether the mutual guarantee was confirmed, which roll holds the lessees' children, and whose names may sign when the compact is renewed.

title.en: The Winter Council

desc.zh: 呼伦的冬天从来不是私事：栅栏、边市与过冬的骑队，每一件都要各部围着同一堆火分摊。谁出草料、谁让道、谁受保护，账算得清，春天才守得住。
desc.en: Winter on the Hulun steppe has never been a private matter: fences, market days and overwintering riders must all be settled around the same fire. Whoever shares the fodder, the road and the protection decides whether spring holds.

title.en: Trade Cannot Be Paid in Garrisons

desc.zh: 冬营的许诺签得再多，也换不回草原的规矩：外军可借道过冬，不可长驻；边市可扩大，不可拿主权抵账。呼伦联盟要把这句话写进盟约，还要让新入盟的城镇也认得它。
desc.en: No promise signed over a winter fire buys back what the steppe holds by custom: foreign riders may pass the cold season by granted term, they may not stand garrison; the market may widen, it may not be mortgaged. The Hulun league means to write that sentence into its compact - and make every newly joined town able to read it.

desc.en: Last winter a night blizzard tore open the Abaga pens and the herds drifted into a neighbour's winter camp. The elders gather by Hulun Lake: where the fence runs, who watches it and who pays - without one shared ledger, next winter will argue the same fight again.

title.en: The Roster of Rotating River Duty

desc.zh: 索伦各屯守渡、巡河、传驿的班次都记在一本轮役簿上，可班次越排越空：有人折费代役，有人托亲顶名，有人干脆不上簿。江上的差事一日无人守，皮货与军粮就一日到不了岸。
desc.en: The Solon villages' ferry, patrol and relay shifts are all written in one roster of rotating duty, yet the shifts grow emptier each season: some households pay silver to be excused, some send a kinsman in their name, and some simply leave the book. While no one minds the river, furs and army grain alike fail to reach the landing.

title.en: The Office Between the Villages

desc.zh: 官署的印记落进了村社之间：渡口添了官册与领薪的书吏，村约仍是旧例，城里的年轻人开始候补。轮役簿的账怎么结，决定这本官文书往后由谁来写。
desc.en: The office's seal has settled between the villages: the ferry crossing now keeps a government roll and salaried clerks, the village covenants remain the old custom, and the young in town wait for vacancies. How the roster's account is closed decides who writes this official book next.

title.en: Who Mans the Crossing This Season

desc.zh: 开春的轮役簿摊在案上，渡口的班次还缺三屯。老把头说人手是各屯的命，收银代役是坏规矩；管渡的书办说皮张折役记账清楚，各屯也愿意。这一季该谁守渡，总得有个写进簿子的章程。
desc.en: The spring roster lies open on the desk and three villages' shifts at the crossing stand unfilled. The old boatmaster says each village's men are its lifeblood and taking silver for duty ruins the custom; the crossing clerk says fur payments make clean entries, and the villages themselves would rather pay. Who mans the crossing this season needs a rule written into the book.

title.en: The Common Fishery on the River Bank

desc.zh: 江湾的渔猎地、靠船的木台与下江的木税，如今记在三本册子上：盟册记村社的旧例，买主的契纸记码头与木排，新来的渔户哪一本都不在。黑水盟要先对齐这三本账，才谈得上河口的长久之计。
desc.en: The fishing grounds of the river bend, the mooring platform and the timber dues downstream now sit in three books: the league roll keeps the villages' old custom, the buyers' contracts keep the wharf and the rafts, and the newcomer fishers are in none of them. The Blackwater League must square these three accounts before the estuary can hold anything lasting.

title.en: The Estuary Gains Permanent Residents

desc.zh: 江岸的账既已结算，河口要面对外面的政策与里面的新一代：南来的章程认不认盟约，不再随季节离开的家庭记在哪一册，续写江岸之约时谁的名字可以落笔。这些账都要按江岸的旧例一件件落定。
desc.en: With the river-bank accounts settled, the estuary faces policy without and a new generation within: whether the southern offices' rules acknowledge the league compact, which roll holds the families that no longer leave with the seasons, and whose names may sign when the riverbank compact is written anew. Each account must be settled by the league's own custom, one by one.

title.en: The Nets That Reached the Bay First

desc.zh: 江湾一年两汛，汛前各家下网的次序向来按盟册的旧例：哪一村先立栅、哪一家先下网，都写在旧约的附页里。可这两年在同一片水里下网的不再只有盟内的村社——新迁来的垦户与南边木排上的伙夫也下了网，旧册上却寻不到他们的名字。管册的长老把盟册摊开：这片渔猎地，按谁的名分算？
desc.en: The river bend runs two fishing seasons a year, and the order of casting nets has always followed the league roll: which village raises its weir first, which household casts first, all written in the compact's appendix. Yet for two years the same water has held nets beyond the league's villages — newly settled households and the cooks of the southern timber rafts cast too, and the old roll has no entry for them. The roll-keeper spreads the book open: by whose standing are these fishing grounds counted?

title.en: Who Repairs the Mooring Platform

desc.zh: 江湾的木台是汛季靠船卸货的地方，如今桩木朽了大半。盟会公议要修，账上却没有现钱；下江的木材买主愿意出全份工料，条件是把码头三成泊位折成他们的专位；村社的长老只肯各修各段，说盟里的台子盟里修。台子等不起，这笔账要现在算。

title.en: The Timber Buyers' New Terms

desc.zh: 一年期满，木台与渔册的账摆上了盟会的案子，木材买主也带来了新条件：与其岁岁议租，不如立一纸出口特许，把下江的木税包销三年，盟里一次收清，村社的渔道与薪林却要让出一段。共管港务能保住裁断——买主、村社与盟会同署理事——却要盟里按年出文书钱。

title.en: Who Inherits the Riverbank Compact

desc.zh: 当年按手立约的长老，有的故去，有的下不了江滩。盟册、木契、南册与长住之家的名目都摊在案上：续写江岸之约的时候，河口长住者、盟内村社与下江买主，谁的名字可以落在纸上？这一代盟人要落的，是最后一笔。
desc.en: The elders who pressed their hands to the compact have died or can no longer walk the bank. The league roll, the timber contracts, the southern roll and the settled families' entries all lie open: when the riverbank compact is written anew, whose names may fall upon the page — the estuary's settled households, the league's villages, or the buyers downstream? That is the last line this generation of league folk sets.

consequence_note.zh: 制度自此巩固：三册之人同具盟约，继序写成年例；渔场、木台与河口名目的记录一并入约正文。
consequence_note.en: The institution is consolidated: all three rolls' people sign the compact and renewal becomes standing custom; the fishery, platform and estuary records enter the compact's own text.

consequence_note.en: The compact renews with capped seats; estuary households beyond the cap wait in line, and the dispute is left to the next generation.

consequence_note.en: The old compact continues as it was, renewed by the league's elders alone; the estuary's and buyers' claims stay on record without changing the old order.

label.en: Withdraw the line; each roll keeps to itself
